name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Regolith goes with none of Captain, Engineer, or Titan.
Lichen goes with at most one of Anders, Engineer, and Europa.
Titan goes with exactly two of Rios, Medic, and Fungus.
Okafor, Engineer, Earth, and Geode belong to different colonists.
Europa goes with exactly two of Okafor, Captain, and Regolith.
